asOf.source: the app's own ledger date, from its 'Ties to TB … as of' line

revenue.source: sum of income accounts on the chart

expenses.source: sum of expense accounts on the chart

burn.source: the app's live monthly burn (_rwVal.burn); time-based, so it moves day to day

clients.source: customers with money received, from the payment records

largest.source: largest single customer by money received

rate.source: the 2027 plan hourly rate (y27.rate) — a plan assumption, not a ledger figure
